extDescription.message: Divvalodu e-pasta tulkošana (oriģināls + tulkojums, blakus). Google dzinējs pēc noklusējuma bez maksas; izmantojiet savu AI modeli (BYOK).

optionMore.description: Divider label before the models.dev providers in the provider dropdown.

optionCustomModel.description: Dropdown option that reveals a free-text model id field.

optionReasoning.description: How much reasoning effort the AI model should spend on a translation.

optionReasoningDefault.description: Send no reasoning parameter and let the provider decide.

providerPlaceholder.description: Disabled first row of the AI provider dropdown until the user picks a provider.

providerRequiredForModel.description: Model dropdown placeholder while no AI provider has been chosen.

providerRequiredError.message: Pirms tulkošanas iestatījumos izvēlieties AI pakalpojumu sniedzēju.

btnOriginal.description: Floating + block button group: the 'show original' engine button label

errorAiNoResponse.message: Nav atbildes no AI pakalpojumu sniedzēja. Lūdzu, pārbaudiet savu API atslēgu un modeļa nosaukumu.
